process.subtitle: A clear, milestone-based process - no surprises, no vague timelines.

steps.title: See If I Qualify
steps.desc: Your consultant reviews your occupation, experience, and visa history. You receive an honest eligibility verdict and recommended pathway.

steps.title: Employer Matching
steps.desc: We search our verified network for employers with current sponsorship approval and an open position matching your occupation and salary requirements.

steps.title: Nomination & Application
steps.desc: Our legal partner Insight Idea prepares and lodges the sponsorship nomination and your visa application, with all documentation reviewed for completeness.

steps.title: Grant & Beyond
steps.desc: Once your visa is granted, we brief you on your rights and obligations as a 482 holder and begin planning your 186 transition timeline from day one.
